[SWS_Rte_08595]
⌈
In case of multiple faults during a call of
Rte_-
Result
the resulting return value shall be derived according to the
following priority rules (highest priority first):
1.
RTE_E_UNCONNECTED
2.
RTE_E_IN_EXCLUSIVE_AREA
3.
RTE_E_SEG_FAULT
4.
RTE_E_COM_STOPPED
/
RTE_E_COM_BUSY
/
RTE_E_TIMEOUT
5.
RTE_E_TRANSFORMER_LIMIT
6.
RTE_E_HARD_TRANSFORMER_ERROR
7. "application error"
8.
RTE_E_SOFT_TRANSFORMER_ERROR
⌋
(SRS_Rte_00028)
The
RTE_E_NO_DATA
,
RTE_E_TIMEOUT
, and
RTE_E_UNCONNECTED
return values are not considered to be
errors but rather indicate correct operation of the API call.
When the
RTE_E_TIMEOUT
error occurs, RTE has to discard any
subsequent responses to that request, (see [SWS_Rte_02657]).
